description: Stable dispatcher-backed native capability catalog for China Unicom Cloud Drive. Keep mutable request defaults here so provider code only owns execution, auth, encryption, and error handling.

notes: spaceType, parentDirectoryId, and directoryName are injected by provider-unicom at runtime.
spaceType and target ids are injected by provider-unicom at runtime.
spaceType, type, fileType, id, and name are injected by provider-unicom at runtime.
targetDirId, sourceType, targetType, and selected ids are injected by provider-unicom at runtime.
targetDirId, sourceType, targetType, and selected ids are injected by provider-unicom at runtime; fromFamilyId is added when moving out of family scope.
